description: This script monitors and manages the health status of network components such as cable modem status, IP status, WAN IP, and ping status. It performs checks, updates system configuration, and can trigger device reboot based on network health conditions.

methods.name: t2ValNotify
methods.description: Sends telemetry notification if the telemetry client exists.

methods.name: CheckandSetCMStatus
methods.description: Checks and updates the Cable Modem status in the bitmask.

methods.name: CheckandSetCMIPStatus
methods.description: Checks and updates the Cable Modem IP status (IPv4/IPv6) in the bitmask.

methods.name: CheckandSetWANIPStatus
methods.description: Checks and updates the WAN IP status (IPv4/IPv6) in the bitmask.

methods.name: CheckandSetIPv4PingStatus
methods.description: Pings the default gateway to check IPv4 connectivity and updates the bitmask.

methods.name: CompareStoredAndCurrGWHealthStatus
methods.description: Compares stored and current network health statuses and triggers reboot if needed.

methods.name: RfcRebootDebug
methods.description: Logs system state for debugging before reboot.

methods.name: CheckandRebootBasedOnCurrentHealth
methods.description: Decides whether to reboot based on current network health status.

methods.name: CheckandStoreCurrentHealth
methods.description: Stores current network health status into system configuration.
